objectives.text: Ensure Federal examiners reviewing Bank Secrecy Act compliance receive appropriate annual training relating to anti-money laundering activities and countering the financing of terrorism.

citations.quote: Each Federal examiner reviewing compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act, as defined in section 6003 of the Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020, shall attend appropriate annual training, as determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, relating to anti-money laundering activities and countering the financing of terrorism

obligations.actor: Each Federal examiner reviewing compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act
obligations.action: attend appropriate annual training, as determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, relating to anti-money laundering activities and countering the financing of terrorism, including potential risk profiles and warning signs; financial crime patterns and trends; the high-level context for why AML/CFT programs are necessary; and de-risking and its effect on the provision of financial services
obligations.trigger: reviewing compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act

citations.quote: Each Federal examiner reviewing compliance with the Bank Secrecy Act, as defined in section 6003 of the Anti-Money Laundering Act of 2020, shall attend appropriate annual training, as determined by the Secretary of the Treasury, relating to anti-money laundering activities and countering the financing of terrorism, including with respect to-
(1) potential risk profiles and warning signs that an examiner may encounter during examinations;

(3) the high-level context for why anti-money laundering and countering the financing of terrorism programs are necessary for law enforcement agencies and other national security agencies and what risks those programs seek to mitigate; and
(4) de-risking and the effect of de-risking on the provision of financial services.

obligations.action: in consultation with the Financial Institutions Examination Council, the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, and Federal, State, Tribal, and local law enforcement agencies, establish appropriate training materials and standards for use in the training required under subsection (a)

citations.quote: The Secretary of the Treasury shall, in consultation with the Financial Institutions Examination Council, the Financial Crimes Enforcement Network, and Federal, State, Tribal, and local law enforcement agencies, establish appropriate training materials and standards for use in the training required under subsection (a).

notes: This section imposes duties on Federal examiners and the Secretary of the Treasury regarding AML/CFT training, not directly on the covered financial institutions (depository institutions, MSBs, broker-dealers) that are the primary subjects of the ratified scope's program-establishment obligations. It is included because it concerns the examination/supervisory layer of the federal AML/CFT program regime. The 'Bank Secrecy Act' definition is not given in this section but incorporated by reference from section 6003 of the AML Act of 2020. Text states it contains laws in effect on July 18, 2026, consistent with the pinned 2026 date.
